unit: ROC-AUC (threshold-free) + classification metrics at a fixed decision threshold (accuracy / balanced_accuracy / sensitivity / specificity / precision / f1 / mcc / cohen_kappa / brier)
cohort_rule: per metal: cytotox.build_paper_cohort_indices(df, metal=m) — IC50-present -> metal -> measurement-level dedup -> 76-name non-cancer exclusion; all surviving cell lines
why: BLK-PA18: widen the Krasnov contrast from a single Ru point and one model-class pair to 5 metals x {D-MPNN, LightGBM, XGBoost} on each metal's own paper-funnel cohort and DOI folds, so the cross-cohort gap is attributable to cohort scope rather than model capability.
honest_framing_note: MEASURED only.  The D-MPNN column is merged from --dmpnn-json when supplied and otherwise recorded as absent.  Krasnov published only Ru and Ir; the other three metals have no external reference.  The classification metrics are computed at a FIXED threshold (0.5); they are not threshold-tuned, and the AUC axis remains the primary (threshold-free) metric.
